text.p: International Absorbents Inc said Monday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire First Empire International Ltd in exchange for 14 million International Absorbents common shares.
No other details of the deal were disclosed.

First Empire is a holding company that owns 70 percent of Vusena Forest Corp Ltd, whose holdings in Fiji include two lumber mills and hardwood timber concessions of over three million cubic meters. Additional concessions of over nine million cubic meters of production-grade timber have been pledged to Vusena pending government processing.

"Based on the market price of hardwoods and prices paid for similar timber concessions, we believe Vusena's resources represent a significant increase to our share value," Gordon Ellis, International Absorbents chairman, said in a statement.
